test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the sales (in thousands) of magazines from six branches (A, B, C, D, E and F) of a publishing company during two consecutive years 2021 and 2022. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df7dcfa3b40fe91577d22bf4e46cd8e6aa623e163544e133b3b9bc97874ae8e9.png] 

What percentage of the total sales of branch C for both years is the total sales of branch F for both years? (round your answer up to two decimal places)
solution:
**Calculation:**

The Total sales of branch C for both years = 110 + 95 = 205

The Total sales of branch F for both years = 80 + 70 = 150

According to the question,

⇒ (150/205)× 100

⇒ 73.17%

**∴ The correct answer is 73.17%.**
